module_summary: AXI-lite data-width upsizer: skid-buffered AW/W are joined and the narrow write data/strobe shifted into the wide lane; read lane offsets queue in a FIFO to select the narrow slice of wide read data.

anchors.name: UPSIZE_BUS_DATA_WIDTH.wskd_ready
anchors.why: Joint AW+W accept; pops both skid buffers and loads master AW/W registers

anchors.name: M_AXIL_AWVALID
anchors.why: Master write address valid driven by awvalid register

anchors.name: M_AXIL_AWADDR
anchors.why: Master write address registered from AW skid buffer

anchors.name: M_AXIL_WVALID
anchors.why: Master write data valid driven by wvalid register

anchors.name: M_AXIL_WDATA
anchors.why: Wide write data: narrow data shifted into lane chosen by address bits

anchors.name: M_AXIL_WSTRB
anchors.why: Wide strobes shifted to the addressed lane

anchors.name: S_AXIL_WDATA
anchors.why: Narrow slave write data entering wskd skid buffer

anchors.name: UPSIZE_BUS_DATA_WIDTH.awskd_addr
anchors.why: Buffered write address; low bits select write lane shift

anchors.name: UPSIZE_BUS_DATA_WIDTH.awskd_valid
anchors.why: AW skid output valid, required for joint write accept

anchors.name: UPSIZE_BUS_DATA_WIDTH.wskd_valid
anchors.why: W skid output valid, required for joint write accept

anchors.name: M_AXIL_AWREADY
anchors.why: Master AW ready releasing awvalid/awaddr registers

anchors.name: M_AXIL_WREADY
anchors.why: Master W ready releasing wvalid/wdata registers

anchors.name: UPSIZE_BUS_DATA_WIDTH.rfifo_full
anchors.why: Read lane FIFO full; blocks ARVALID and ARREADY

anchors.name: UPSIZE_BUS_DATA_WIDTH.rfifo_data
anchors.why: Queued read lane offset selecting narrow slice of wide read data

anchors.name: M_AXIL_ARVALID
anchors.why: Read address valid passed through unless lane FIFO full

anchors.name: S_AXIL_ARREADY
anchors.why: Read address ready; also pushes lane offset into rfifo

anchors.name: M_AXIL_ARADDR
anchors.why: Read address pass-through; low bits pushed into rfifo

anchors.name: M_AXIL_RDATA
anchors.why: Wide master read data captured by rskd skid buffer

anchors.name: UPSIZE_BUS_DATA_WIDTH.rskd_valid
anchors.why: Read skid output valid loading rvalid

anchors.name: UPSIZE_BUS_DATA_WIDTH.rskd_ready
anchors.why: Read skid pop when slave R channel can accept

anchors.name: UPSIZE_BUS_DATA_WIDTH.shift_rdata
anchors.why: Wide read data shifted down by lane offset to narrow width

anchors.name: S_AXIL_RVALID
anchors.why: Slave read valid from rvalid register

anchors.name: S_AXIL_RREADY
anchors.why: Slave read ready advancing R registers and skid buffer

anchors.name: S_AXIL_RDATA
anchors.why: Narrow read data from rdata register

anchors.name: S_AXIL_RRESP
anchors.why: Read response forwarded from master via rresp

anchors.name: S_AXIL_BVALID
anchors.why: Write response valid passed straight from master

groups.name: Write address/data join
groups.description: AW and W skid buffers synchronized by wskd_ready before upsizing

groups.name: Write upsizer
groups.description: Registers master AW/W and shifts narrow data/strobe into the addressed wide lane

groups.name: Read lane FIFO
groups.description: Queues read address lane offsets; full flag throttles read address channel

groups.name: Read downsizer
groups.description: Skid-buffered wide read data shifted by lane offset into narrow R registers
